name: Varad Parte
intro: I build AI systems that turn unstructured documents and enterprise data into searchable knowledge, structured outputs, and reliable workflows.
about: My work spans LLM engineering, retrieval-augmented generation, document intelligence, and agentic automation. I build with Python and Azure, with an emphasis on grounding, evaluation, and human-in-the-loop review.

points: Built an internal document-intelligence platform with Azure Document Intelligence, OCR, and Python to convert scanned lease PDFs into searchable enterprise knowledge and structured metadata.
Developed custom AI skills that turn recurring IT and business workflows into repeatable, agent-executable tasks.
Built an internal AI Wiki that structures business context so agents retrieve grounded information when executing business tasks.
Partner with IT stakeholders on AI improvements across Azure Cosmos DB, Azure Logic Apps, and Power BI.
Designed document-ingestion and extraction workflows to normalize OCR output, segment legal clauses, and extract lease terms, dates, and escalation schedules, reducing manual review time by over 53%.
Developed internal applications with SQL, Python, REST APIs, and database-backed workflows. Expanded QA and audit coverage contributed to a 27% reduction in application downtime.
Worked with leasing stakeholders, QA teams, and senior engineers to translate business workflows into automation and validation logic, with deployment workflows across Dev, QA, and Production.

projects.title: Enterprise GenAI Risk & Sentiment Monitoring
projects.summary: A GenAI platform that turns web and news coverage into entity-matched sentiment signals, reputational-risk assessments, and stakeholder-ready reports.
points: Built a modular FastAPI backend with Celery, Redis, and PostgreSQL, including provider abstraction, deduplication, and confidence-based entity resolution.
Implemented LLM-assisted classification and schema-validated structured outputs, with auditable metadata and human review.

projects.title: Multi-Agent AI Assistant for Project Management
projects.summary: A tool-using AI assistant that coordinates Jira operations, ticket routing, and workload distribution through natural-language queries.
points: Architected multi-agent orchestration with CrewAI, Langflow, and LLMs, plus persistent memory and retrieval for project status and dependency insights.
Designed reusable prompts, context flows, and retrieval patterns that reduced manual project-management effort by 40%.

projects.title: Full-Stack Hackathon Operations Platform
projects.summary: An event operations platform supporting registration, judging, and live-event workflows for hundreds of participants.
points: Built with Next.js, Node.js, KeystoneJS, and GraphQL to support the full event lifecycle.
